summary: 药品包装、说明书和标识会影响用药安全。文章比较儿童防护、信息排序和辨识设计，说明设计规范怎样把患者的实际需要落实到包装上。

paragraphs.brief: 药品包装的患者安全隐患
sentences: One of the most prominent design issues in pharmacy is that of drug packages and the patient information leaflets (PILs) included in them.
在药学领域，药品包装及其随附的患者说明书是最突出的设计问题之一。
Many pharmacists are concerned that current designs are ‘accidents waiting to happen’.
许多药师担心，现有设计潜藏着迟早会引发事故的危险。

The UK government shares this concern and, in 2003, the National Patient Safety Agency created a new role, appointing Colum Lowe, who has 14 years’ experience as a designer in the private sector, as head of design and human factors.
英国政府也有此担忧，国家患者安全机构于2003年新设设计与人为因素主管一职，任命了拥有14年私营部门设计经验的科勒姆·洛。
paragraphs.gist: 药师担心现有药盒和患者说明书的设计会酿成事故，英国国家患者安全机构因此设立设计与人为因素主管一职。

paragraphs.brief: 处方药与非处方药设计流程
sentences: Packaging design in the pharmaceutical industry is handled by either in-house teams or external design agencies.
制药业的包装设计由内部小组或外部设计机构负责。

For packaging design of over-the-counter medicines, which do not have to be dispensed by a pharmacist but can be bought directly from a sales assistant, characteristics such as attractiveness and distinguishability are important and so these are usually commissioned from an external design team.
非处方药不需药师调配，顾客可以直接向店员购买，因此包装需要吸引人、便于辨认，这类设计通常会委托外部团队。
The marketing team prepares the initial brief and the designers come up with six or seven designs.
营销团队先拟定设计要求，设计师据此提出六七套方案。
Two or three of these are then tested on a consumer group.
再从中选两三个方案，请一组消费者试用。
In contrast, most designs for prescription-only products are created in-house.
相比之下，大多数处方药的包装由企业内部设计。
In some cases, this may simply involve the company’s design team applying the house design and then handing it over to design engineers rather than testing the design on a consumer group.
有些公司只是由内部设计团队套用统一样式，随后交给设计工程师，并不请消费者测试。
Clearly this process cannot adequately address the needs of the wide variety of patients using medication.
显然，这一进程无法充分满足使用药物的各类病人的需要。
paragraphs.gist: 非处方药包装通常由外部设计者提供多个方案并经消费者测试，处方药却常直接套用公司设计，较难照顾不同患者的需要。

paragraphs.brief: 误读标签与真实用药情境
sentences: In her book Information Design for Patient Safety, Thea Swayne highlighted a multitude of design problems.
西娅·斯韦恩在《面向患者安全的信息设计》中指出了许多设计问题。
For example, drugs that look or sound alike can lead to confusion; small type sizes and even the glare on silver-foil packaging can lead to names or instructions being misread.
例如，药品外观相似或药名读音相近，都容易造成混淆；标签字号太小，甚至银色铝箔包装的反光，也可能使人看错药名或使用说明。
One such example is a drug that was accidentally injected into a patient through the spine (intrathecally) rather than through the veins (intravenously).
曾发生过这样一起事故：一种本应经静脉注射的药物，被误从患者的脊柱处作了鞘内注射。
Investigations following this tragedy attributed some blame to the poor choice of typescript used on the drug container.
事后调查认为，药品容器标签选用的字体不当，是酿成悲剧的原因之一。

Furthermore, according to Swayne, real situations in which medicines are used include a parent giving a cough medicine to a child in the middle of the night; packaging should be designed for moments such as these rather than for the ideal world of a hospital.
斯韦恩还指出，家长半夜给孩子喂止咳药，也是用药的真实场景，包装设计应考虑到这样的时刻，不能只按医院的理想条件来设想。
paragraphs.gist: 相似药名、小字和反光铝箔都可能引发误读，作者用给药途径误认的事故与家长深夜喂药的情境说明包装应适应真实使用条件。

paragraphs.brief: 兼顾儿童与老人的开盖设计
sentences: Child protection is another area that gives designers opportunities to improve safety.
保护儿童安全是另一个可通过设计加以改进的方面。

According to the Child Accident Prevention Trust, 70% of children admitted to hospital with suspected poisoning have swallowed medicines, and although child-resistant lids have helped, they are not yet fully effective.
据儿童意外事故预防基金会称，在因疑似中毒而住院的儿童中，70%曾吞服药品；防儿童开启的瓶盖已有帮助，但尚不能完全防止误服。
There is scope for improving what is currently available, according to Richard Mawle, a freelance product designer who feels it is not just children who are blocked by child-proof closures.
自由产品设计师理查德·莫尔认为，现有产品还有改进余地，因为被防儿童开启的瓶盖难住的不只是儿童。

‘Many child-resistant packs are based on strength but older people may have the same level of strength as a child,’ he explained, and suggested that better designs could rely on cognitive skills (e.g. removing the lid using a three-step process).
他解释说，许多防儿童包装靠手劲才能打开，但有些老年人的力气跟孩子差不多。他建议改用需要理解操作步骤的设计，例如分三步开盖。
paragraphs.gist: 防儿童开启的药盖虽能降低误服风险，单靠手劲却也挡住部分老人，设计者建议尝试依赖认知步骤的开启方式。

paragraphs.brief: 说明书的重要信息顺序
sentences: Mawle also worked on a project which involved applying his skills to packaging and PILs.
莫尔还参与过一个改进药品包装和患者说明书的项目。
Commenting on the information presented, he said: ‘There can be an awful lot of junk at the beginning of PILs.
谈到说明书的内容，他说：“患者说明书开头可能塞了太多无关紧要的信息。
For example, why are company details towards the beginning of a leaflet when what might be more vital for the patient is that the medicine should not be taken with alcohol?’
例如，为什么公司的资料摆在说明书前面，而对患者来说可能更要紧的是，服这种药不能喝酒？”
paragraphs.gist: 莫尔质疑药品说明书开头堆放公司资料的做法，认为患者更需要及时看到与安全使用有关的信息。

paragraphs.brief: 剂量色标可能影响阅读
sentences: Most designers work according to basic principles; for example, certain print styles are known to be more difficult to read than others.
大多数设计师根据基本原则工作；例如，人们知道某些印刷风格比其他印刷风格更难阅读。
Look-alike boxes present the potential for errors and an obvious solution would be to use colours to highlight a larger dosage of a drug.
外观相似的药盒容易使人拿错药，一种看似显而易见的做法是用颜色突出较高剂量的规格。
However, according to Thea Swayne, designating a colour to a particular dosage is not recommended because this could lead to the user not reading the text on a box.
但斯韦恩并不建议给特定剂量固定配色，因为使用者可能只看颜色，不去读药盒上的文字。
paragraphs.gist: 相似药盒容易混淆，但专家也反对只用指定颜色提示剂量，担心使用者会依赖颜色而忽略文字。

paragraphs.brief: 真实场景中的包装效果
sentences: Design features can provide the basis for lengthy debates.
设计特点可以作为冗长辩论的基础。
One argument is that if all packaging was white with black lettering, people would have no choice but to read every box carefully.
有人主张，如果所有药品都用白底黑字的包装，人们就只能仔细阅读每个药盒。
The problem is that trials of drug packaging are few – common signage studies concern road-traffic signs and visual-display units.
问题在于，关于药品包装的实际试验很少，常见的标识研究对象是交通标志和显示设备。
Although some designers take results from such studies into account, proving that a particular feature is beneficial can be difficult.
虽然有些设计师考虑到这些研究的结果，但很难证明某一特征是有益的。

For example, current UK legislation requires packaging to include the name of the medicine in Braille, but, according to Karel van der Waarde, a design consultant to the pharmaceutical industry, ‘it is not known how much visually impaired patients will benefit nor how much the reading of visually able patients will be impaired’.
例如，英国当时的法规要求用盲文在包装上标明药名，但制药业设计顾问卡雷尔·范德瓦尔德指出：“视障患者能受益多少，以及这会在多大程度上妨碍视力正常者阅读，目前都不清楚。”
Van der Waarde is sceptical about current legislation and says that many regulatory authorities do not have the resources to handle packaging information properly.
Van der Waarde对现行立法持怀疑态度，说许多监管当局没有适当处理包装信息的资源。
‘They do not look at the use of packaging in a practical context – they only see one box at a time and not several together as pharmacists would do,’ he said.
他说：“他们没有在实际使用情境中审视包装，每次只看一个药盒，而药师面对的却是同时摆在一起的好几个。”
paragraphs.gist: 药品包装的实测研究有限，从黑白字样到盲文的实际效益都须检验，监管者一次只看一个药盒也难反映药师的真实工作情境。

paragraphs.brief: 从易用设计到行业标准
sentences: On a positive note, a recent innovation exhibition revealed several new designs.
最近的一次创新设计展也带来了好消息，展会上出现了好几种新设计。

‘The popper’ aims to help arthritis sufferers remove tablets from blister packs, and ‘Pluspoint’ is an adrenaline auto-injector (a device that allows diabetics to inject themselves) aimed at overcoming the fact that many patients do not carry their medication due to its prohibitive size.
“The popper”旨在帮助关节炎患者从泡罩包装中取出药片；“Pluspoint”是一款肾上腺素自动注射器，旨在解决装置体积过大、患者不愿随身携带的问题。原文将自行注射与糖尿病患者联系起来，此处举例有误：肾上腺素自动注射器用于严重过敏反应的急救。
The aim of good design is to try to make things more user-friendly as well as safer.
好的设计既要使产品更好用，也要使它更安全。
The guidelines in Information Design for Patient Safety are not intended to be legally binding.
《面向患者安全的信息设计》中的指南并不打算成为有法律约束力的规定。
Rather, the book’s purpose is to create a basic design standard and to stimulate innovation.
相反，这本书的目的是制定基本的设计标准和刺激创新。
The challenge for the pharmaceutical industry is to adopt such a standard.
制药业面临的挑战是采用这种标准。
paragraphs.gist: 帮助关节炎患者取药及便于携带的注射器展示了设计改进的方向，行业面临的任务是采用以安全和易用为目标的基本标准。

items.en: The elderly would benefit from drug containers that do not require force to open them.
items.zh: 不用很大力气就能打开的药品容器对老年人有益。

items.en: Adapting packaging for the blind may disadvantage people who can see.
items.zh: 为盲人改造包装可能不利于能看的人。

items.en: Specially designed containers have not been able to eliminate drugs being swallowed accidentally.
items.zh: 专门设计的药品容器仍未能完全防止意外误服。
items.answer: B · The Child Accident Prevention Trust
items.solution: 儿童事故预防信托基金

items.en: Designers have to consider how drugs are used in the home.
items.zh: 设计师必须考虑家里如何使用药物。

items.en: Governing bodies need to compare different drug containers rather than studying individual ones.
items.zh: 监管机构需要对不同药品包装进行比较，而不能只单独研究每一种包装。

items.en: Information provided with medicine is not listed in the right order.
items.zh: 提供的药品资料没有按正确的顺序列出。

items.en: Packaging design in the pharmaceutical industry Over-the-counter drugs First, a proposal is written by the ________.
items.zh: 设计非处方药包装时，首先由 ________ 撰写方案。
items.why: “proposal/brief”对应“营销团队先写初始方案”。

items.en: Then several designs are produced by the ________.
items.zh: 接着，由 ________ 提出几种设计。
items.why: 回到对应内容“非处方药不需药师调配，顾客可以直接向店员购买，因此包装需要吸引人、便于辨认，这类设计通常会委托外部团队”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: Finally, selected designs are shown to ________.
items.zh: 最后，把筛选后的设计展示给 ________。
items.why: 选定方案给消费者小组测试。

items.en: Prescription-only drugs The ________ create the design.
items.zh: 处方药的包装由 ________ 设计。
items.why: 处方药多数由公司内部团队完成设计。

items.en: The design is then passed to ________.
items.why: 内部设计完成后转交工程师 (而非做消费者测试)。

groups.label: 选词填空
groups.instructionsZh: 阅读带空格的中译，回想正确词项及其字母。

items.en: In the accident mentioned in the passage, what was the ‘design consideration’ that caused a drug to be given incorrectly?
items.zh: 文中所举事故中，哪项设计因素导致给药方式出错？

items.en: What do some people say about the use of only black and white as a design feature?
items.zh: 一些人对只用黑白来设计有什么看法？
correct: People would pay more attention to label information.
人们会更加关注标签信息。

items.en: Why does the writer refer to ‘the popper’ and ‘Pluspoint’?
items.zh: 作者为什么提到“the popper”和“Pluspoint”这两项产品？
correct: to show that progress is being made in pharmaceutical packaging design
表明在医药包装设计方面正在取得进展

pairs: 题干用名词，定位句改用同词根的动词。
points: 回到对应内容“非处方药不需药师调配，顾客可以直接向店员购买，因此包装需要吸引人、便于辨认，这类设计通常会委托外部团队”，再按题干要求写出答案。
题干问“设计师必须考虑家里如何使用药物”。定位句写到“此外，Swayne认为，使用药物的真实情况包括父母在半夜向儿童提供咳嗽药；包装应针对这样的时刻，而不是医院的理想世界”。
clauses: “that current designs are ‘accidents waiting to happen”补足 concerned 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 concerned 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
One such example is a drug … ).
“that was accidentally injected into a patient through the spine (intrathecally) rather than through the veins (intravenously”修饰前面的 drug。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 drug，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: How improved drug packaging could provide some answers to patient safety issues
改进药品包装，怎样帮助解决患者用药安全问题？
